## Portfolio projects

- Cost-Optimized Portfolio Hosting: https://holdenjolley.com/projects/resume/
  Deployed Azure Static Web Apps Free architecture designed around a target of $0/month Azure hosting within included quotas, secretless GitHub OIDC, Bicep, ARM What-If, managed TLS, and a deliberately minimal Azure footprint. The canonical personal domain is routed through Cloudflare to the Azure-hosted portfolio.

- Distributed E-Commerce Platform: https://holdenjolley.com/projects/ecommerce/
  Azure reference architecture using Front Door + WAF, App Service, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, private networking, managed identity, observability, and regional resilience. Dev/test/prod Bicep validates, and the dev architecture has passed live ARM What-If through GitHub OIDC.

- Privacy-Preserving AI Age Assurance: https://holdenjolley.com/projects/age-verification/
  Azure reference architecture using client-side envelope encryption, private Container Apps inference, Key Vault Premium/HSM-backed keys, anti-replay state, Private Link, managed identity, and no intentional image retention. Foundation/workload Bicep validates, and the dev foundation has passed live ARM What-If through GitHub OIDC.

- Hybrid Kubernetes Chaos Lab: https://holdenjolley.com/projects/hybrid-kubernetes-chaos/
  Physical kubeadm Kubernetes cluster on Ubuntu Server connected to Azure through Arc-enabled Kubernetes and managed through Flux GitOps. The lab uses containerd and Calico and includes measured runtime chaos evidence: a deleted replica recovered from 2/3 to 3/3 Ready in 6.89 seconds with 109/109 successful Service requests; a replica remained Running/Ready with zero restarts during 30.73 seconds of bounded CPU saturation with 110/110 successful Service requests; and a NetworkPolicy experiment proved a selected pod IP reachable before, unreachable during, and reachable after isolation while the Service completed 100/100 requests successfully. All current application replicas run on one physical node, so node-level high availability is not claimed.

## Validation boundary

- Infrastructure is authored and validated using project-appropriate controls: Bicep/ARM What-If for Azure reference architectures and Kubernetes manifests/Flux reconciliation for the hybrid lab.
- GitHub Actions authenticates to Azure through secretless OpenID Connect workload identity federation.
- The portfolio hosting project is deployed to Azure Static Web Apps Free and is the live origin for the public portfolio.
- The hybrid Kubernetes lab is a live physical cluster connected through Azure Arc with Flux GitOps and recorded runtime chaos experiments.
- The e-commerce and age-assurance projects remain reference architecture packages with compiler/control-plane evidence; they are not presented as complete production customer applications.
- Runtime evidence is reported only for conditions that were actually exercised. The hybrid lab currently proves pod/service behavior, not physical node resilience.

## Professional background

Holden has 5+ years of experience across Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, endpoint security, hybrid infrastructure, and automation. Work described in the resume includes Azure VM migration and operations, endpoint modernization from on-premises management to Entra ID/Intune/Autopilot, identity lifecycle automation, least-privilege endpoint security, and workflow automation. The portfolio additionally demonstrates hands-on Kubernetes, Azure Arc, Flux GitOps, Calico networking, and controlled resilience testing.
